svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 200 mm disc from 4 mm steel plate; deburr the edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark twelve lines from the centre, 30 degrees apart. These are

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rib lines; the clips sit 1.5 mm to one side of each line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On each line, offset 11.5 mm to the clip side, drill 5.5 mm at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 72.5 mm from the centre for the clip bolt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the back; the front is hidden behind the petals.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the ribs' inner ends stand on its front face, each held by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a rib clip; it hangs about 22 mm behind the petals.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the twelve holes are on a 72.5 mm radius within 1 mm.
